split_justification.separation: normative and determinative stay in separate commits; positions 1 to 4 are normative, position 5 is determinative
split_justification.reason: The owner permitted splitting the normative part across several commits after a context break left finished work uncommitted. Each position is coherent on its own and is committed only when its own tests and the affected gate modes are green, so no position depends on a later one to be correct.
condition_per_commit: the position is self contained: it introduces no reference to an artifact a later position creates
the full tooling test suite passes
the configuration loader binding check passes
no position leaves the guard in a state where it cannot decide
split_justification.context_rule: If the context runs short, work stops before the commit and reports, rather than leaving finished work unsecured or committing it unverified.

guard_package_affected.reason: The runtime package gains tools/guard/fixture.py and the guard version moves to 1.2.0, so the package content and its digest change.
guard_package_affected.activation_point: owner decision, outside this block; no gate of this block depends on the activation

plan_change.change: positions 2 and 3 swapped before either was committed
plan_change.reason: The owner fixed the order for the continuation: loader and metagate, then the fixture configuration, then the target bound rule, then the profile derivation, and only after that the register tool, the block manifest, the runner and the missing tests. The plan follows that order rather than the other way round.

second_change.decided_by: agent, under the owner's standing permission to split the normative part
second_change.change: the former position 4 is split into a runner commit and a manifest commit
second_change.reason: A block manifest references its runner by argv. Committing the manifest first would create a position that points at something the same commit does not contain, which the split condition forbids. The runner therefore lands first and is green on its own against every declared mode; the manifest follows and is green against the engine and a real preflight run.

plan_deviation.declared_condition: each position is committed only when its own tests and the affected gate modes are green
plan_deviation.what_happened: Position 5 was committed after preflight and targeted passed. The offline-final phase, which was not run before that commit, then failed on of-repo-guard: the manifest declared a product guard allowlist scoped to this block, while the product guard compares against the repository wide guard base and therefore spans earlier blocks.
plan_deviation.assessment: The declared condition was met as stated but was too weak. A block manifest is only coherent once every phase it declares has run against it.
plan_deviation.remedy: The scope correction is a separate normative commit rather than a silent part of the determinative one, and the closing run is performed against the corrected manifest.
plan_deviation.condition_sharpened: A commit that introduces or changes a block manifest is green only when every phase that manifest declares has run against it.
